LW.comparison_scope: one captured column/one LW or SW call; table, masks, phase state and all cloud/radius/precipitation/frozen inputs unchanged

flux_and_heating.flux_endpoint_convention: input pressure descends from near-surface at index 0 to TOA at index -1; HR k is one-based native-order index

SW.comparison_scope: one captured column/one LW or SW call; table, masks, phase state and all cloud/radius/precipitation/frozen inputs unchanged

flux_and_heating.flux_endpoint_convention: input pressure descends from near-surface at index 0 to TOA at index -1; HR k is one-based native-order index

scope.calls: one LW and one SW call, each baseline and dry-column counterfactual
scope.important_limit: The experiment isolates sensitivity to replacing only 44 native layer dry masses by the corresponding actual RRTMG4 legacy COLDry/COLDRY columns. It does not establish which engine is more accurate, nor generalize to domain behavior.
